name: dumbbell bent arm pullover hold
description: Holding a dumbbell over your chest with bent arms in a pullover position. It keeps the chest and lats under tension.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
Lower it behind your head with your elbows bent.
Stop where you feel a stretch in your chest and lats.
Hold the position with your core tight.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lift it back up.
